# RFP ACT SACT 26-95

Request for Proposal for **Project, Program, and Portfolio Management (P3M) Training**.

**Bid closing date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, no later than **05 November 2026, 0900 hours**, Eastern Standard Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-95**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026095.pdf)

[**Price Proposal Amendment #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026095_pricing_amdt1.xlsx)

[**Questions & Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026095_qa1.pdf)
